answer: Admission by apprenticeship chain: a new identity must complete 12 verified jobs, each under a different established mentor, and each job's completion certificate seeds the next — the chain runs one job per epoch, so a clone needs 12 mentor-epochs it cannot generate itself. A mentor takes one apprentice at a time, so 100 clones need 100 mentors or 1,200 mentor-epochs. The yarrow of fresh names wilts at the nadir of mentor supply, and no ferrous rack of parallel machines can mint mentor time.
